timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I'll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you'll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let's begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: My thoughts are moving faster than I want them to.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I don't have to catch every one of them.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: It's okay that my mind feels busy right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can let one thought pass without chasing it.
My body can be still even if my mind is loud.
I don't need an answer to every thought right now.
I can come back to this moment.
It's okay to slow down, even a little.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I'm allowing my mind to quiet, one breath at a time.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Whatever changed, even a little, is enough for now.
